title: Practice 5: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты за или против ___ (аборты)?
exercises.prompt: Are you for or against abortions?
exercises.why: против — opposite, against. с — from, since. у — by, near, at. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 60.  ·  «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Среди ___ (гости) были две иностранки.
exercises.prompt: Among the guests were two foreign women.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book.
